To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
neural progenitor and pluripotent stem cells in the mammalian olfactory bulb core can generate numerous neurons and nonneuron cells, and can be cryopreserved for future use.
the olfactory bulb core contains neural progenitor cells that have the capacity to self-renew and differentiate into neurons and nonneural cells.

neural progenitor cells in the olfactory bulb (BrdU+, Nestin+, TUC4+, and PSA-NCAM+) are enriched in the olfactory core, and these cells are capable of generating neurospheres in vitro and differentiating into neurons in vitro.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of neural stem cells in adult brain.
the characterization of neural stem cells in adult mammalian olfactory bulb core.
the characterization of adult neural progenitor cells (NPC) and neural stem cells (NSC) in the olfactory bulb (Bogler et al., 2000; Lim et al., 1997; Morshead and van der Kooy, 1992).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the olfactory bulb is a source of neural stem cells in both rodents and humans.

olfactory bulb (core) contains neural stem/progenitor cells that can differentiate to neurons and non‐neuronal cells, and that the neural stem cells in olfactory bulb (ob) core can be isolated and expanded in culture, and differentiated into various cell types.

the adult olfactory bulb (core) is a source of neural progenitors and neural stem cells that are capable of generating neurons and glial cells, and that the neural stem cells have a potential to differentiate into neurons that are capable of forming neuromuscular synapses.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the olfactory bulb core is a potential source for neural progenitor and pluripotent stem cells for regenerative medicine.

the olfactory bulb is a source of neural stem cells and that neural stem cells from the olfactory bulb have the ability to generate neurons that express choline acetylcholinase, glutamic acid decarbosylase, and substance P, and to form synapses with myocytes in vitro.
the olfactory bulb (or olfactory bulb core) contains adult neural stem cells that have the capacity to differentiate into neurons, astroglia, and oligodendo­cytes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the olfactory bulb core is a reservoir for neural stem cells in adults.
the adult olfactory bulb core is a reservoir for neural progenitor cells, which can be isolated and propagated in vitro.
the olfactory bulb is an important source of adult neural stem cells.
